_comment: TEAM-5426: rfq233's security review completion, reconstructed. The summary leads with 'Changes needed' and carries 5 severity-tagged findings; the review went Done on it and released TEAM-5358/5359 four seconds later.
summary:
Changes needed: 1 Critical, 4 High

- [Critical] The RFQ upload endpoint accepts a presigned PUT for any key under the bucket prefix; scope the key to the caller's tenant.
- [High] Supplier quotes are readable by any authenticated user; add a tenant check on GET /rfq/{id}/quotes.
- [High] The pricing webhook does not verify its HMAC signature.
- [High] Quote attachments are served inline with the uploaded Content-Type; force Content-Disposition: attachment.
- [High] The audit log omits the acting principal on quote award.
